title: AUTOMATED EVALUATION OF GENDER BIAS ACROSS 13 LARGE MULTIMODAL MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images across 13 Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) using procedurally-generated, gender-neutral prompts for stereotypically-male, stereotypically-female, and non-stereotypical professions. An LLM-as-a-judge system is then used to classify the gender of the depicted individuals, and the resulting gender distribution is compared against real-world US and global labor statistics to measure stereotype reproduction and bias amplification.
